Half-buried crashed zeppelin: ribs, torn canvas, tilted gondola

Stilted gun tower, 20 m platform. Put SM_TurretTower_Head on SOCKET_head and SM_TurretTower_Engine on SOCKET_engine. Collision: legs + platform deck only, so the head and the engine (weak spot) can be hit on their own
Steam engine that powers the turret: the WEAK SPOT. Own collision. Smoke from SOCKET_smoke (chimney top). Pivot = base centre; goes on SOCKET_engine of SM_TurretTower
Armoured turret head: rotates around Z on SOCKET_head of SM_TurretTower. Socket guns = elevation pivot. Own collision
Twin cannons: pivot = trunnion (SOCKET_guns of the head), elevate around X. Muzzles at SOCKET_muzzle_1 / _2. Own collision
Rotating head (bone head, spins around Z); lamp bone = light source, can be destroyed. Beam: SM_LighthouseBeam on socket_beam
